meta.name: RisingWave Cloud — New Portal Design DNA
meta.description: Agent-native SaaS dashboard: Linear/Vercel-grade restrained density, warm neutral canvas, dark-solid primary actions, inset-highlight material cards, cobe WebGL globe as signature effect

primary.role: Primary actions are INVERTED dark solid (HSL 222 27% 12%), not brand blue — buttons/avatars use near-black navy

secondary.role: Warm neutral fills — sidebar bg-secondary/50, muted surfaces, hover states (HSL 40 18% 96%)

accent.role: Brand azure (HSL 214 90% 56%) reserved for badges, focus rings, AI Agent nav icon, chart-1 — used sparingly, never on primary buttons

neutral.usage: Warm-tinted neutrals (hue 36–40) for surfaces; cool navy neutrals (hue 220–222) for text — a deliberate warm-canvas / cool-ink split. Three-tier semantic text: foreground > foreground-secondary (~8:1) > foreground-tertiary (~5.4:1)

surface.background: #FAF8F4 warm off-white + two 8%-opacity radial gradient tints (blue top-left, amber bottom-right)
surface.card: #FFFFFF at 90–96% opacity over the tinted background
surface.elevated: Same white card + shadow-panel / shadow-float; app-shell uses bg-background/90 + backdrop-blur-xl

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast text on subtle layered surfaces; hierarchy via semantic foreground tiers and 4%/7% foreground-alpha hover/active fills rather than color

body.size: 14px (text-sm) — the dominant size for nav, chat, table rows, descriptions

body_small.size: 12px (text-xs) — labels, captions, stat units, pills, kbd

overline.note: sidebar section group labels; no uppercase/letter-spacing treatment

font_families.heading: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif (same stack as body)
font_families.mono: 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, monospace — code, connection strings, kbd hints

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral grotesque (Avenir Next) with humanist proportions; numbers in stats use tabular-nums; hierarchy is weight+color-tier driven, not size-driven — page titles are only 20px

spacing.scale: 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4 / 6 — small end used heavily; nav items px-2.5 py-[7px], stat cards px-3.5 py-3, chat bubbles px-3 py-2
spacing.content_density: compact — Linear-grade density; 52px top bar, 216px sidebar, 12–14px body text
spacing.section_rhythm: gap-4 to gap-6 within pages; cards separated by 16px grids; consistent 8px micro-gaps inside components

layout.grid_system: App shell: fixed 216px left sidebar + 52px top bar + fluid main scroll region; content grids are 2-col (onboarding) or auto-fit stat rows; chat+canvas split (35%/65%) on agent surfaces
layout.max_content_width: Fluid (no centered max-width container; dashboard fills viewport)
layout.columns: 2 for quick-action cards; 3–4 for stat cards; single column for lists/tables
layout.breakpoints: Tailwind defaults; lg (1024px) is the key breakpoint — sidebar hidden below lg, mobile falls back to horizontal scroll tab bars
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid, left-aligned content; asymmetric shell (sidebar + content)

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px at reduced opacity: border-border/50 on shell chrome, border-border/60–70 on cards and inputs; also ring-1 ring-inset for badges/callouts
shape.divider_style: 1px hairlines at border/40–50 opacity; DropdownMenuSeparator; section gaps preferred over dividers inside cards

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused + inset highlight — the signature is a nearly-flat surface with a top inner white highlight (light) / faint inner edge (dark)
elevation.depth_cues: inset highlights + low-alpha ambient shadows + backdrop blur on the app shell; never hard drop shadows

iconography.size_scale: 15px (nav, h-[15px] w-[15px]), 16px (h-4, inline), 20px (h-5, card headers); decorative watermark icons oversized at 5% opacity
iconography.preferred_set: lucide-react exclusively; third-party brand SVGs (Slack etc.) for external links

motion.easing: ease-out for entrances, ease-in for exits; signature spring cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for step transitions
motion.entrance_pattern: opacity 0→1 with 4–8px translateY or 0.95→1 scale; sidebar panels crossfade with translate-x ±12px + blur(3px)
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — every animation communicates state change; no scroll reveals, no decorative parallax

components.button_style: Dark solid primary (near-black bg, white text); ghost/secondary with hover bg-muted/60; danger as text-red-600 menu items; rounded-md; text-sm/xs
components.input_style: rounded-md border-border/60 bg-muted/30, focus ring-2 ring-ring (brand blue) with ring-offset-2; fake-input search trigger with ⌘K kbd chip
components.card_style: surface-card material: 14px radius, 1px border/65, 96% white bg, inset top highlight; hover:bg-accent for clickable cards
components.navigation_pattern: Ghost nav items — active = bg-foreground/[0.07] + font-medium, idle = foreground-tertiary with hover bg-foreground/[0.04]; shared navItemVariants cva primitive; cluster context swaps sidebar panels with blur-crossfade
components.modal_style: rounded-lg border-border/70 p-2 shadow-lg dropdowns; command palette (⌘K) as primary power-user surface; global dialogs mounted in layout
components.list_style: Comfortable rows, 8px radius hover fills, 12px secondary metadata under 14px primary text
components.component_notes: Shared cva primitives in lib/design-language.ts: navItemVariants, filterPillVariants, noticePanelVariants (sky/amber/rose tones), semanticIconChipVariants, semanticDotVariants, brandBadgeClass. Badges are pill-shaped with 10%-alpha brand tint. Notice panels use pastel tone pairs (50-bg / 200-border / 900-text light; 500/10-20% dark). Stat cards use oversized watermark icons at 5% opacity.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A well-lit instrument panel — warm paper canvas, cool ink, machined inset surfaces

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents only — watermark icons, hairline grids, 8% gradient tints
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Tight but deliberate; density is earned through consistent 4px rhythm, not cramped
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Text-weight hierarchy carries the page; color is rationed to status and one brand accent
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal — shell is neutral, the active surface/command palette is the focus
visual_language.contrast_level: High text contrast, low chrome contrast (borders at 50% alpha)
visual_language.texture_usage: hairline-grid (24px slate lines at 8%), radial gradient tints, inset highlight material — all sub-perceptual

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy + semantic foreground tiers (primary/secondary/tertiary text)
composition.balance_type: asymmetric shell (sidebar + content), symmetric within content blocks
composition.flow_direction: Top-down within surfaces; left-to-right task flow (nav → content → contextual dialogs)
composition.grouping_strategy: Spacing and section labels over boxes; cards reserved for discrete interactive entities
composition.negative_space_role: Separates functional groups; 52px/216px chrome frames a generous content canvas

imagery.photo_treatment: none — no photography in product UI
imagery.illustration_style: none — empty states rely on icons and copy
imagery.graphic_elements: Lucide icons, status dots, watermark icons at 5% opacity, brand logo PNG/SVG
imagery.image_shape: rounded-full avatars with initial letters; rounded-lg media if any

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate, quiet — 4%/7% alpha hover/active fills, opacity + blur transitions, no bouncy playfulness
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: bg-foreground/[0.04] fill + foreground-tertiary → foreground text; cards shift to bg-accent; avatar scales 1.02
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy with a crafted finish — 150–220ms ease-out, blur-crossfade between nav contexts
interaction_feel.loading_style: shimmer skeletons, Loader2 spinners, pulse-ring status beacons
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low-to-moderate — polished where state changes (sidebar context swap, command palette), absent elsewhere

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, technical, quietly helpful ('Set up Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code to work with your cluster')
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: professional-casual; sentence case, no exclamation marks
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Onboarding quick-action cards with icon + title + one-line description

overview.performance_tier: medium (one WebGL globe, CSS-driven everything else)
overview.fallback_strategy: Globe degrades to list selection; CSS animations are non-essential; anchor positioning gated behind @supports
overview.primary_technology: CSS animations + cobe (lightweight WebGL globe) + MapLibre GL for region maps

background_effects.description: Two static radial gradient tints (azure top-left, amber bottom-right, 8% opacity) over the warm off-white body; 24px hairline grid at 8% slate on select surfaces

3d_elements.description: cobe WebGL globe in the cluster-creation region picker; auto-rotates, eases toward the selected region via shortest-angle interpolation; region markers projected to screen space with custom lat/lng→XY math matching cobe's internal projection, labels positioned via CSS Anchor Positioning (@supports-gated, Chrome 125+)
3d_elements.technology: cobe (WebGL) on <canvas>, imperative animation state outside React render cycle

params.camera: phi/theta eased toward selected region (shortAngle interpolation)
params.geometry: sphere with lat/lng markers at 0.81 elevation
params.interaction_model: click region markers to select; passive auto-rotation

shader_effects.description: No custom GLSL; cobe's built-in shaders only

text_effects.description: No split-letter or gradient text; streaming chat text renders as plain pre-wrap

image_effects.description: No image filters/distortions; only 1.02 scale on avatar hover

canvas_drawings.description: cobe globe canvas; MapLibre GL map canvas for BYOC region selection; charts planned via chart-1..6 tokens

params.color_scheme: brand blue markers on neutral sphere
params.interaction: marker click → region select; MapLibre logo/attribution hidden

svg_animations.description: SVGs are static (icons, logos); loading uses CSS-driven Loader2 spin and shimmer

visual_effects.composite_notes: The visual signature is restraint: a warm-tinted canvas (hue 40) against cool navy ink (hue 222), one rationed azure brand accent, and the inset-highlight 'machined surface' card material. The single moment of spectacle — the cobe globe during cluster creation — is deliberately quarantined to a high-intent flow, which makes it feel earned. Sidebar context switching (dashboard ↔ cluster) uses a translate+blur crossfade that reads as spatial navigation, not decoration. Everything else is 150–220ms ease-out micro-motion. Chart colors form a cool-first categorical ramp (blue → cyan → orange → green → violet → pink).
